annotations.text:
Three looks for the Light Play concept — pick one (or mix parts).
Move your cursor across each design: the light follows it. The 'metal' switch above each board previews gold-plated.
All photos, names and prices are real pieces from blingitonjewels.com.

A · Night Vault
Silver glints hardest on black — the cursor works like a jeweller's spotlight and pieces flare as it passes. Feels premium, and dark frames calm their mixed photo backgrounds.
Tradeoff: moodier and more 'luxury' than their 30–75 JOD, playful Instagram feel; colourful enamel charms look less at home.

B · Hallmark Gallery
Bright gallery walls, a giant 925 hallmark that shines under the cursor, catalogue numbers on every piece. Clean, confident, the most fashion-editorial of the three.
Tradeoff: on a light background the glint is subtler, and their inconsistent photo backgrounds stand out more.

C · Chrome Candy
Leans into the name 'Bling it on': liquid-chrome lettering, sticker price tags, playful Arabic type. Closest to their Instagram crowd and the most unlike other jewelry sites.
Tradeoff: trend-led, so it may date faster, and it's a less natural home for Ayat al-Kursi and Palestine heritage pieces.
